name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This pin (QVAC-21598 branch HEAD b7e1bf46) enables the validated Parler Vulkan pipeline on ARM Mali instead of silently falling back to CPU on Pixel hardware. It carries master 0a306445, including the CosyVoice3 dl-safe backend fix, bounded Parler DAC decode, always-sampling Parler generation, Vulkan/Metal/OpenCL GPU support, and the CosyVoice3 engine. The ggml-speech floor is unchanged because this release only changes engine-side backend selection.
